habitat: Pairs or groups near rivers and in open areas in any woodland or thornveld, usually hawking from a low branch or a fence.
summary: A common resident. Small, with a yellow throat, orange-buff underparts and a square tail. A V-shaped black band on the upper breast separates the yellow throat from rufous underparts. The immature lacks the black collar and has pale green underparts. The call is a quiet chip, chip, trree-trree-trree. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

underparts.pattern: Orange-buff underparts. A V-shaped black band on the upper breast separates the yellow throat from rufous underparts. Orange-buff is not a single token.

tail.shape: Squarish tail. A tail colour was not named.
